prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened at the time of the collision.

A: I was driving on a city street in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. The traffic was light. A car came from the opposite direction and drifted into my lane, and we ended up meeting head-on. It wasn't a high-speed hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward and then back into my seat.

Q: What was your approximate speed just before impact?

A: I'd say I was going maybe twenty miles an hour, maybe a little less. I had just started to slow down for a turn.

Q: Did the other driver say anything or give any reason for drifting over?

A: They said they looked down at a phone for a second. I didn't see that myself, but that's what they told me on the roadside.

Q: Were there any airbags deployed in your vehicle?

A: No, they didn't go off. The car was driveable, and we were able to pull to the shoulder.

Q: When did you first notice any physical symptoms?

A: Right away I had a stiff neck, but the worst of it was my lower back. By that evening it was really tight and sore, and I could barely bend over the next morning.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They diagnosed a lumbar strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some instructions for stretching. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Have you had any prior issues with your back?

A: I had some occasional stiffness years ago, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal activities.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?

A: Just that I'm still having trouble sleeping through the night because of the pain, and I want to make sure my treatment is covered. Thank you for your help.

Q: Thank you. That concludes our statement.
